blockers: Phase 6d: The 4 sorries require a new helper lemma (prior_zone3_exist_transfer) that proves existential transfer by well-founded induction on sub_nf depth, with arity universally quantified, using Prior-UZ/SZ for zone-3 witness placement at each level. This is a ~200-400 line proof that restructures the zone-3 argument from scratch. The current proof structure (strong induction on K proving 2-var only) has an irrecoverable off-by-one: nf_eval_nf at depth d+1 has quantifiers at depth d, so depth-(K+1) 3-var transfer needs depth-(K+2) 2-var (the theorem being proved).

continuation_context.key_insight: The resolution is to prove a new lemma by induction on depth d (decreasing) with universally-quantified arity r (increasing). At each depth level: (1) find zone-3 witness via Prior-UZ applied to char_fn formula in interval (t',x'), (2) verify atoms from zone placement + 1-var type matching, (3) verify quantifier conditions via IH at depth d-1 (arity r+1). The induction terminates at d=0 (atoms only). The witness w₂ from cross_extend_bwd_1var should be REPLACED with r0 from HasAttainedINF.first_occ (which guarantees t' < r0 < x').

continuation_context.proof_sketch: The new lemma proves: given 1-var agreement at depth D for env components + Prior-UZ/SZ + order matching + char_fn, the existential transfer at depth d <= D and any arity r holds. Proof by Nat.strongRecOn on d. At d=0: zone-based atomic witness (Prior-UZ for between-zone). At d+1: find witness r0 via Prior-UZ in correct zone, verify atoms, then for each depth-d (r+1)-var quantifier condition, apply IH at depth d with the extended env (r0 is now part of the base env, and the new existential variable z needs zone placement among r0,x',t'). The IH applies because d < d+1.
